gitBanner.noBranches.title: No git branches yet
gitBanner.noBranches.description: jj uses git internally, but nothing is visible in the git world until you explicitly create a branch (bookmark).
gitBanner.noBranches.hint: Use this command to create a "main" branch on your current working copy. Once created, the git commit graph will appear here.
gitBanner.branches.description: Showing commits reachable from git branches created via jj bookmark
gitBanner.allRefs.independentNodes: Nodes appear independent because jj stores each snapshot as an independent root commit. These are jj's automatic working copy saves, which look like unrelated commits from git's perspective.
jjBanner.timestampHint: Timestamp = when jj last detected file changes and created a snapshot (auto-updated on jj command execution)
detail.evolog.subtitle: Rewrite history of the same change (click to show diff)
detail.evolog.explanation: Commit ID changes but change ID stays the same = jj's "rewrite changes" model. jj automatically creates new snapshots each time you edit files.
detail.changedFiles.subtitle: Files changed in this commit
detail.divergent.title: Divergent Change (??):
detail.divergent.description: The same change ID {{changeId}} has diverged into multiple commits. This often occurs due to conflicts between describe and automatic snapshots.
detail.divergent.abandonHint: to discard the unwanted one, or
detail.divergent.opRestoreHint: to restore to before the divergence.
hint.root: Virtual root shared by all repositories. This concept does not exist in git.
hint.workingCopyEmpty: @ = working copy (empty). Unlike git, the working copy itself is a commit. No git add needed. Use jj new to create a new empty commit.
hint.workingCopy: @ = working copy. Changes are recorded automatically (no git add needed). Split: jj split / Squash into parent: jj squash
hint.immutable: immutable: cannot be rewritten. Excluded from jj rebase targets. Similar to protected branches in git.
hint.divergent: divergent (??): same change ID has diverged into multiple commits. Often occurs when jj describe and automatic snapshot happen simultaneously. Use jj abandon to discard one, or jj op restore to revert.
hint.conflict: conflict: has conflicts. Unlike git, you can commit with conflicts. Resolve with jj resolve.
hint.empty: empty: no changes. Created with jj new. Git requires --allow-empty for empty commits, but in jj this is normal.
hint.normal: Regular commit. Use jj edit to directly edit past commits (equivalent to git rebase -i).
gitHint.jjKeep: jj internal snapshot. jj auto-saves the working copy. Visible in git but not in jj log. Separate from jj's change ID.
gitHint.headAndBranch: HEAD + branch. Move with git checkout. In jj, move with jj new / jj edit (HEAD is auto-managed by jj).
gitHint.head: HEAD: git's current position. Equivalent to @ (working copy) in jj. git checkout = jj edit.
gitHint.branch: git branch = jj bookmark. git branch = jj bookmark create. git merge = jj new branchA branchB.
gitHint.rootCommit: Root commit. Created by jj for internal management. Different from git's initial commit.
